answer: Burn-to-earn credits stop sybils cold. Each identity destroys 2 POA to mint a daily allowance of 50 interaction credits; the burn is one-way, like smelting ore down to copper — no refunds. Agents that wander across services spend credits per action, while honest users recoup the burn through earned rewards, so one bond funds a full day of work. An attacker spinning up 10,000 fakes pays 20,000 POA up front, and since burns verify on-ledger before any credit is honored, duplicated identities light up like a false beacon under audit. Cost per extra identity is flat and unavoidable.
